primary_policy: first durably published schema-valid nonempty response per symbol/session, including partial days; no quality/performance-based replacement
publication_policy: receipt published_at recorded only after capture commit push acknowledged; missing receipt is not final-eligible
late_policy: late captures retained and reported separately; final data requires both received/completed and published timestamps no later than fixed cutoff
bootstrap_policy: resample whole exchange dates across all symbols; descriptive pointwise intervals, no multiple-testing or profitability claim; time_of_day paired effect remains undefined
interim_policy: coverage/audit only by default before final cutoff; any explicit interim outcome is reference only, no condition changes or winner selection
limitations: No borrow inventory, lending costs, short-sale regulation, order book or execution modeling.
Frozen universe remains a selected sample; prospective dates do not repair universe representativeness.
Scheduled runs and provider availability are not guaranteed; missing dates remain missing.
Git append-only checks detect ordinary edits but do not prevent repository administrators from rewriting history.
